author: ProdigyBE
quote:
Now that the original creators left the company, and a new woke team took over, they removed so many things that made GTA .. well GTA. It has lost it’s soul. And that is a true crime.

Gameplay-wise, it’s a bad game as well. Very few of the mission of the main storyline are actually fun, the main characters are bland and annoying, and you just stop caring after a while. 

All this budget spend by a dev team led by people who do not have the skills to create a banger. What a waste.

Good job in manipulating the press tho. The Rockstar and Take Two guys are awesome at that. The gaming press should be ashamed.

author: ProdigyBE
quote: Control Resonant is a pinnacle in storytelling and level design. It comes close to being a piece of art. But underneath as well, there’s true innovation. Like the difficulty setting, that can really be tailored to optimal enjoyment. More games should do that, instead of just going Easy/Normal/Hard
